approach: The force is the negative slope of the potential energy, so setting it to zero and solving for the nonzero position gives the answer.

steps.text: Differentiate U(x) with respect to x.
Write the force and set it to zero.
Factor and solve, keeping the nonzero root.

common_mistakes.text: Taking x = 0, the trivial root where the object has not moved at all, instead of the nonzero position asked for.
